purposeAndScope.purpose: Pre-register an auditable capture envelope for future release-authority evidence before any eligible comparison or outcome inspection.
purposeAndScope.unit: One candidate release and its immediate retained predecessor, each with version-specific evidence references only.
purposeAndScope.noObservationBoundary: This artifact defines a future capture procedure. It does not contact a registry, repository, transparency log, provider, API, archive, package artifact, or workflow endpoint.
purposeAndScope.noPayloadBoundary: The contract does not download package tarballs, install packages, execute package code, resolve dependencies, or retrieve a package artifact merely to attempt authority collection.
purposeAndScope.noOutcomeBoundary: Authority capture must complete and pass quality control before a separately retained future outcome manifest is made available to the capture operator or analysis process.

allRequiredBeforeAnyCapture: The primary control-frame contract is satisfied by a frozen package-version population and independently adjudicated, target-matched outcome coverage over a pre-registered horizon.
The delta-semantics protocol and a field-specific collection plan are frozen with source-specific historical retention and time-validity rules.
The selected release and immediate retained predecessor are version-addressable source objects that precede the relevant release cutoff.
An access-controlled evidence store, encryption key-custody record, and immutable append-only capture ledger are provisioned outside the public repository.
The campaign-relatedness validation-unit registry is frozen, but it is withheld from capture operators until after raw-evidence quality control is sealed.
prohibitedActivationFallbacks: Do not substitute a current package root document, dist-tag, maintainer roster, repository profile, workflow view, VCS branch, or account state.
Do not replace an unavailable predecessor with a nearest semantic version or a later retained release.
Do not collect source evidence after looking at outcomes, incident labels, risk scores, rankings, or model results.

captureManifestSchema.description: One immutable manifest for a future, completed collection run. Every field below is a schema requirement, not an observed value in this artifact.
forbiddenFields: Raw repository URLs, revision strings, publisher identifiers, account identifiers, workflow text, certificates, tokens, credentials, provenance statements, or canonicalized authority values in the public manifest.
Outcome labels, incident labels, control labels, model scores, ranks, or metric values in the collection manifest.
A boolean named unchanged, safe, benign, clean, trusted, or no_known_event as a fallback for missing or ambiguous evidence.
captureManifestSchema.opaqueReferenceRule: Each opaque reference must resolve only through an access-controlled evidence store. It must not be a reversible encoding, a raw value, a public URL, or a deterministic public hash of a low-entropy authority value.

immutableRawEvidenceRequirements.byteIntegrity: Store the exact received evidence bytes in the access-controlled store and record SHA-256, byte length, media type, retrieval timestamps, and retrieval-protocol identifier in the append-only ledger.
immutableRawEvidenceRequirements.sourceProvenance: Record source evidence class, version-specific source-object reference, response status category, and documented source semantics without publishing raw headers, credentials, identities, or values.
immutableRawEvidenceRequirements.redactionBoundary: If an evidence object contains credentials, personal data, or security-sensitive material, retain only an approved minimal derivative under a documented redaction procedure; record the derivative relationship and redaction-policy identifier without exposing either object publicly.
immutableRawEvidenceRequirements.chainOfCustody: Every transformation must append a parent-object opaque reference, transformation-function identifier and version, operator-role opaque identifier, timestamp, and resulting byte digest. Overwrite and in-place mutation are prohibited.

opaqueCanonicalizationLedger.goal: Permit future equality or transition checks without publishing raw authority values or enabling a public dictionary attack against low-entropy identifiers.
requiredControls: Canonicalization must be deterministic under the declared function version and parameter-set digest, and must never follow redirects, resolve a hostname, query current repository ownership, inspect a current VCS branch, or perform a network request.

Use an access-controlled keyed commitment for canonical outputs; neither the key nor a raw or unhashed canonical value may enter the repository, public artifact, test fixture, log, or benchmark table.

A canonicalization failure, malformed value, unavailable source, or ambiguous field must remain an explicit non-eligible reason; it must not become an empty string, equality, unchanged state, or negative outcome.
The same declaration must be used for both predecessor and selected release evidence before either canonical output is accessed for a future comparison.

decisionVocabulary.time_valid_for_opaque_capture: Required time relations and source semantics are documented; this permits capture only, not a public comparison or outcome join.
decisionVocabulary.not_time_valid: A required release, predecessor, binding, timestamp, or source-semantics condition fails.
decisionVocabulary.time_ambiguous: Available evidence cannot establish the required time relation or binding; do not capture a substitute value.
decisionVocabulary.not_applicable: The declared delta type cannot be meaningfully tied to the release regime.

fieldCollectionSchemas.sourceTimeRule: Each descriptor must be retained inside its own version-specific release object selected before the relevant cutoff.
fieldCollectionSchemas.noCurrentStateSubstitute: No redirect follow, repository ownership lookup, current URL resolution, or current repository metadata is permitted.

fieldCollectionSchemas.sourceTimeRule: Each reference must be bound to its release object and accompanied by the pre-registered registry-semantics record.
fieldCollectionSchemas.noCurrentStateSubstitute: No current branch, tag, commit, repository, or VCS availability query is permitted.

fieldCollectionSchemas.sourceTimeRule: Each fragment must be retained in its version-specific manifest and parsed by the declared schema version.
fieldCollectionSchemas.noCurrentStateSubstitute: Missing manifest fields remain unobservable; do not infer a workflow, actor, or build system.

fieldCollectionSchemas.sourceTimeRule: The signed evidence must be bound to the release artifact and its time relation to publication must be documented.
fieldCollectionSchemas.noCurrentStateSubstitute: No current badge, provenance page, unverified log search, or package download is a substitute under this metadata-only contract.

fieldCollectionSchemas.sourceTimeRule: Historical retention and field semantics must be independently documented for each version-specific evidence object.
fieldCollectionSchemas.noCurrentStateSubstitute: No current maintainer roster, account profile, publisher page, or registry root document is permitted.

fieldCollectionSchemas.sourceTimeRule: Both workflow states must be retrieved at exact historical revisions and bound to their releases by verified provenance or an equivalently time-valid evidence chain.
fieldCollectionSchemas.noCurrentStateSubstitute: No default-branch workflow, current repository setting, or public workflow absence is a substitute for historical revision evidence.

sequence: Freeze the field-specific collection plan and its hash before any source contact.
Verify source-object and time-validity eligibility without revealing an outcome manifest.
Collect only the pre-registered minimum evidence object through the declared metadata-only access path.
Seal raw bytes and append source provenance plus byte-integrity records in the access-controlled evidence store.
Execute the declared offline canonicalization and write only opaque commitments and reason codes to the public-safe ledger.
Conduct independent quality control against the frozen contract and seal the decision before any outcome join, grouping, model, or metric stage.
abortConditions: Any source requires a package payload, package installation, code execution, unapproved authentication, or a guessed endpoint.
Any required source-time binding, historical retention guarantee, semantic record, or canonicalization control is absent or ambiguous.
The collector can see target outcomes, incident labels, controls, scores, rankings, or model results before sealing quality control.

prohibitedInterpretations: This contract is not a raw-evidence collection, a current-state audit, a delta comparison, or an authority assessment.
An opaque reference, digest, or commitment is evidence-integrity metadata only; it is not a release-authority value, a security score, or proof of a change.
Unavailable, missing, redacted, malformed, current-only, or time-ambiguous evidence must not be recoded as unchanged, safe, benign, trusted, or no-known-event.
No capture run may be used for controls, outcomes, effects, scores, rankings, models, intervals, calibration, or predictive metrics until every separate benchmark gate is met.
